author: Sega Jenesis
title: Hiring digital artists for custom Pokémon binder scenes
content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀 I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway! Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚 If you’re an artist or know someone who might be interested, please send them my way! I’d love to see portfolios, pricing, and availability. 🥰 Contact via comments or DM on Threads.

author: Meg Humble
title: Looking for character artists for 2 full body characters under £300
content: I know imma regret this, but I’m looking for character artists who have space in November for 2 full body characters (no background needed) ideally for less than £300 🚫 AI 🚫 DMs Authors please also rec people you have used! 🥰 Reply in the comments with availability/art examples. Contact: reply to the post (no DMs).

author: Or Cole
title: Seeking character artist for upcoming romance book, flexible payment
content: I'm looking for an artists that can do character art for my up coming book. And who's willing to work with me because money is tight. So a lot up front wouldn't work but I can definitely pay you what you're worth. Just not up front. No AI please. I am so fucking serious no AI please! I am a romance author. Contact via comments or DM on Threads.
